3-Bedroom Modular Container Home

Sustainable, Fully Customizable, Modular Living Solutions

The 3-Bedroom Container Home is a modular residential solution engineered for families, communities, and property developers who demand quality without the delays of traditional construction. This model brings together purpose-built container modules into one cohesive, comfortable living space.

Every dimension, finish, color, partition, and fixture you see in the renderings is fully customizable. Whether you're building a residential home, a coastal property, or a remote development site, our engineering team works with you to adapt the design to your land, climate, and lifestyle requirements.

If you are interested in this 3-bedroom container house floor plan, please contact us and let us know your site location, intended use, and any customization preferences, and we will provide you with a detailed proposal and quote.

Why Choose a 3-Bedroom Modular Container Home?

Modular and Scalable: Each of the three container house units can be shipped separately and assembled on-site, allowing for easy expansion by adding modules.

Fully Customizable Interiors: Flooring, wall colors, furniture layouts, cabinet finishes, and fixtures can be selected from our catalog or customized to your specifications.

Rapid Construction: Factory prefabrication reduces on-site construction time from months to days. From foundation preparation to move-in, on-site construction takes only 2–4 weeks.

Superior Structural Integrity: Constructed with ISO-grade hot-dip galvanized steel frames that withstand seismic magnitudes of up to 9 and wind speeds of scale 12 (32.7–41.4 m/s).

Thermal and Sound Insulation: High-performance composite wall panels with core materials such as EPS, rock wool, foam, or polyurethane. Wall and roof panels can also be selected to suit your specific geographic location.

Relocatable and Reusable: Modular construction means the entire home can be disassembled and relocated if you need to move in the future.

Eco-Friendly and Sustainable: Material waste is significantly lower than in traditional construction. Optional features include solar roof panels, rainwater harvesting systems, and greywater recycling systems.

Who Suits a Modular 3-Bedroom Container Home?

Primary Residences — Suitable for permanent or temporary housing, fully equipped with utilities

Vacation Cabins — Tourist cabins for hotels or resorts, available for seasonal or year-round use

Community Housing — Low upfront construction costs enable affordable rental housing for low-income populations

Worker Accommodations — Provide rapidly deployable and portable housing units for construction sites, mining areas, or military bases

Affordable Housing — Serving NGOs and developers in need of scalable housing solutions

Airbnb and Short-Term Rentals — Unique container home designs can be used as short-term accommodations to generate rental income

Disaster Relief and Emergency Housing — Providing rapidly deployable housing units for communities affected by natural disasters

We offer a wide range of customization options, from exterior wall colors and roof styles to premium finishes and smart home technology, to help you create the ideal home that fits your lifestyle and budget. Contact us today for a consultation and a personalized quote.

NEW BRAND: Modular Container Homes Manufacturer

NEW BRAND has been engineering and delivering modular container housing solutions for over a decade. Our factories are ISO-certified, our engineering team holds international structural and architectural credentials, and our customer support team is available across the US, EU, and Asia-Pacific time zones.

• Manufacture approximately 500 container houses daily

• All container homes comply with ISO, CE, and relevant local building codes

• Post-delivery support: technical documentation, videos, spare parts, and on-site service

• Transparent pricing: no hidden fees, itemized quotes provided upfront

Ready to build your modular 3-bedroom container home right now? Contact our team for a consultation, custom quote, and 3D rendering of your project.

Frequently Asked Questions

1
Can I get permits for a container home in my state or county?
Modular container homes can be permitted as permanent residences, accessory dwelling units (ADUs), or temporary structures, depending on local zoning. We can help you provide engineering drawings, material certifications, and compliance documentation to support your permit application. We recommend consulting your local building department before purchase.
2
Are the dimensions fixed, or can I change them?
Yes, our engineering team can modify any dimension based on your site requirements and preferences. Custom sizing is available with adjusted lead times and pricing.
3
Can the layout be changed from what's shown in the floor plan?
Absolutely. The interior walls can be repositioned, bathrooms can be relocated, the kitchen can be moved to a different module, and additional rooms or storage areas can be incorporated. We provide renderings of any custom layout before production begins.
4
How is the 3-bedroom container home insulated?
This three-bedroom container home features insulated sandwich panels, with core options including EPS, rock wool, polyurethane, or foam. You can also provide us with details about your local climate so we can recommend the most suitable insulated sandwich wall panels and roof panels.
